SCOPE: at D/h=23.9 the resolved FBM already carries most of the film (G2: FBM alone -15/-26 percent below Brenner), so the correction is modest BY CONSTRUCTION - unlike ten Cate's LBM which had no resolved film below one grid spacing and needed the full Eq.-10 force; the digitized PIV (~11 samples in the window, velocities at the measurement floor) cannot discriminate base vs deficit (broad-window rms 10.2 vs 10.3 percent E1, 17.4 vs 18.0 E2 - the E-family sim-vs-experiment gaps of D1.3 dominate). The quantitative model certification is G2/G2b; G3 certifies the qualitative Fig.-13 behavior and the absence of the landing pathology in the production configuration.
